Package robbery.backpacks

Class Backpacks

java.lang.Object
robbery.backpacks.Backpacks
public class Backpacks extends Object
Represents a backpack in the Robbery plugin.

Each backpack has a name, capacity, price, material, color code, and a list of contained items. Provides methods to add, sell, or empty items, and generate a display ItemStack.

      public Backpacks(String name, int capacity, List<Items> items, org.bukkit.Material material, int price, String colorname)
      Creates a new backpack with the given parameters.
      Parameters:
      name - display name of the backpack
      capacity - maximum capacity of the backpack
      items - initial list of items to store, can be null
      material - material of the backpack item
      price - purchase price of the backpack
      colorname - color-coded name string using 'invalid input: '&'' codes

    • Backpacks

      Parameters:

      extraSlots - number of extra slots to add to the capacity
